headline: T. ROWE PRICE GROUP, INC., DECLARES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: T. Rowe Price Group (NASDAQ-GS: TROW), a global asset management firm and a leader in retirement, announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.30 per share payable on September 29, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on September 15, 2026.

headline: Defense tech Hadrian raises $1.37B at $8B valuation
summary: Hadrian is building automated factories to mass-produce parts for defense vehicles like submarines. It's backed by a long list of well-known investors.
